analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 22,590) vs SMA5 (KRW 24,387) / SMA20 (KRW 26,907) / SMA50 (KRW 31,458): diagnosed below short- to mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 33,675) / SMA200 (KRW 36,466): indicating strong downward pressure on mid- to long-term trends.
· 52-week position (13.9%) + current price level entering historical low territory.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.8→35.4): entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-87.4177→-104.6709): worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at KRW 21,562) + band width at 39.73% expanding then starting to contract.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (KRW 17,490) + basis (based on 52-week low).
· Swing resistance level (KRW 24,575) + potential for short-term bounce upon breakout.
· 5-day / 20-day high-low pattern (potential breach of 20-day low at KRW 22,485): possibility of continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.97x vs 5-day average): normal level, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) + entry/wait conditions: Wait for support confirmation at KRW 22,485; prepare for further decline if breached.
